Overall verdict: **needs_changes**. The implementer’s target declaration is correct, and its recorded commands contain no forbidden shapes.

FINDING (high, correctness): The configured sink invokes an unsupported Buzz CLI interface. Evidence: [notify_buzz.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/notify_buzz.py:276) calls `buzz-cli post --relay --community`, while the official CLI installs `buzz` and sends with `buzz messages send --channel <uuid> --content -`, using `BUZZ_RELAY_URL` for community selection; the mocked tests explicitly assert the invalid argv. [Official Buzz CLI contract](https://github.com/block/buzz/blob/main/crates/buzz-cli/README.md). Recommendation: use the documented binary/command/environment contract and update tests accordingly.

FINDING (medium, documentation): The config example does not identify `relay_url` as the authoritative private-community URL and instead introduces a separate community ID unsupported by the CLI. Evidence: [GETTING_STARTED.md](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md:174) shows generic `relay_url` plus `community`, although Buzz defines the relay URL as the workspace/community authority. Recommendation: align the config, doctor schema, and copy around the operator’s private community URL and channel UUID, retaining the warning against public support communities.
